description: REQUIRES prior nhis_edi__session__login call with same account_link_id. Returns the screen id and page link id of the NHIS EDI all-forms menu screen after preparing this session's work screen. It does not open that screen, and it returns neither a form list nor any form file. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).
